defense_in_depth_findings.summary: Preflight mode validates pinned interior fields of the authorization document rather than pinning the document's own sha256.

No composition or authority flows from preflight (it verifies and closes descriptors only), and any future real event requires a separately released wrapper, so this is hardening only.

statement: Independent adversarial review of the committed F017 representative FFN composition package at feat/017-real-checkpoint-runner head f75040f6894754fab22fdeb9541e7f8a5030b292 (origin parity, clean worktree).
